title: Finite derived Hom comparison is natural in both arguments
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $n\geq0$, and $g:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ a scheme isomorphism with $\ell$ invertible on $X$ and $Y$. Use the finite derived pullback $F=Lg^*$, derived tensor $T$, internal Hom $H$, evaluation and closed transposition at $A_{E,n+1}$ [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations], the canonical tensor comparison $\mu$ [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-comparison], and the finite evaluation-defined comparison $c_{M,N}:FH(M,N)\to H(FM,FN)$, the transpose of $\mu^{-1}_{H(M,N),M}$ followed by $F(\mathrm{ev}_{M,N})$ [def-pod-system-hom-reindexing-maps]. For all $M,N,M',N'\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n+1})$, $a:M'\to M$ and $b:N\to N'$: $$c_{M',N'}\circ F(H(a,b))=H(Fa,Fb)\circ c_{M,N}.$$

proof.text: Both sides are maps $FH(M,N)\to H(FM',FN')$; since closed transposition is a bijection [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations], compare their transposes $T(FH(M,N),FM')\to FN'$.

By parameter naturality of transposition, the transpose of the left side is $T(F H(a,b),1)$ followed by $\mu^{-1}_{H(M',N'),M'}$ and $F(\mathrm{ev}_{M',N'})$ (definition of $c$ [def-pod-system-hom-reindexing-maps]). Naturality of $\mu$ [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-comparison] moves $F H(a,b)$ inside $F$, and dinaturality of evaluation, $\mathrm{ev}_{M',N'}\circ T(H(a,b),1)=b\circ\mathrm{ev}_{M,N}\circ T(1,a)$, gives $F b\circ F(\mathrm{ev}_{M,N})\circ\mu^{-1}_{H(M,N),M}\circ T(1,Fa)$ after a second use of naturality of $\mu$.

The transpose of the right side is $Fb\circ\mathrm{ev}_{FM,FN}\circ T(c_{M,N},1)\circ T(1,Fa)$ by the same dinaturality on $X$, and $\mathrm{ev}_{FM,FN}\circ T(c_{M,N},1)=F(\mathrm{ev}_{M,N})\circ\mu^{-1}_{H(M,N),M}$ is the counit identity of the transpose defining $c_{M,N}$. The two transposes agree, so the two maps agree.

lean.statement:
theorem podFiniteHomComparison_naturality (n : ℕ)
    (M N M' N' : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)))
    (a : M' ⟶ M) (b : N ⟶ N') :
    (finiteDerivedPullback l E n g).map
        ((finiteIntrinsicDerivedInternalHom l E Y n).map (Prod.mkHom a.op b)) ≫
      podFiniteHomComparison l E g n M' N' =
    podFiniteHomComparison l E g n M N ≫
      (finiteIntrinsicDerivedInternalHom l E X n).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((finiteDerivedPullback l E n g).map a).op
          ((finiteDerivedPullback l E n g).map b))
